description: Deny piped, container, and encoded variants in the secret and operator-path guards (deny-env-dump.sh), with failing-first tests and no prose regression.

userStories.title: Deny stdin-fed interpreter scripts that read a secret from the environment
userStories.description: As the operator, I want `deny-env-dump.sh` to inspect a script that a heredoc or a pipe feeds to an interpreter. Then a stdin script cannot read `DATABASE_URL` past the guard.
acceptanceCriteria: Red first: the worker adds the deny cases below to `.agro/scripts/__tests__/hooks.test.ts` and runs the file. The worker records that each new deny case fails before the hook change.
The hook denies `node - <<'EOF'` with a body that reads `process.env.DATABASE_URL`.

The hook denies `node <<'EOF'`, `python3 - <<'EOF'`, and `bash -s <<'EOF'` when the body reads the environment. Environment reads are `process.env`, `os.environ`, `getenv`, `%ENV`, `$ENV{`, and `ENV[`. A `$NAME` or `${NAME}` reference to a secret-named variable also counts.
The hook denies a pipe into a bare interpreter, for example `echo 'console.log(process.env.DATABASE_URL)' | node`, and `printf '%s' "$x" | python3 -` when the left side names an environment read.
The hook allows a stdin interpreter heredoc whose body reads no environment value, for example `node - <<'EOF'` with `console.log(1)`.
The hook allows a prose heredoc that names `process.env.DATABASE_URL`: `gh pr create --body-file - <<'EOF'`, `git commit -F - <<'EOF'`, and `cat > notes.md <<'EOF'`.
The denial reason names the remedy: the operator runs the command and pastes only the non-secret value.
`corepack pnpm vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/hooks.test.ts` exits 0.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: worker ran hooks.test.ts before the hook change, exit 1 with 22 failures (21 new deny cases + reason test); echo|bash case already denied by the echo rule. 2-6 executed: advisor reran `corepack pnpm vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/hooks.test.ts`, exit 0, 230 passed 3 skipped; cases cover node -, node, python3 -, bash -s heredocs, bare-interpreter pipes, here-string, benign stdin script, and prose heredocs (gh pr create --body-file -, git commit -F -, cat > notes.md). 4: `printf '%s' "$x" | python3 -` names no env read, so it is an allow case; the deny variant uses os.environ on the left. 7 executed: test asserts the reason contains 'Ask the operator to run the command' and 'paste only the non-secret value'. 8 executed: exit 0; worker full suite shows only the 7 baseline herdr-default failures.

userStories.title: Deny secret-named environment reads through container and remote exec
userStories.description: As the operator, I want `deny-env-dump.sh` to deny `printenv`, `env`, and `echo` of a secret-named variable inside `docker exec`, `agro hands exec`, `ssh`, and `bash -c`. The guard then stops a container secret from reaching a database URL.
acceptanceCriteria: Red first: the worker adds the deny cases below to `.agro/scripts/__tests__/hooks.test.ts` and records that each new deny case fails before the hook change.
The hook denies `docker exec db printenv POSTGRES_PASSWORD`; today the `ASK` pattern returns `ask` for this command.
The hook denies the same read through `podman exec`, `kubectl exec`, `agro hands exec <name> --`, `ssh <host>`, and `bash -c 'printenv GH_TOKEN'`.
The hook denies `docker exec db env | grep PASSWORD` and `docker exec db sh -c 'echo $POSTGRES_PASSWORD'`.
The hook keeps `ask` for a local `printenv HOME`, and allows `docker exec db psql -c 'select 1'`.
The denial reason names the remedy: the operator runs the command and pastes only the non-secret value.
`corepack pnpm vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/hooks.test.ts` exits 0.

userStories.title: Deny encoded operator and secret paths
userStories.description: As the operator, I want `deny-env-dump.sh` to decode `base64 -d` and `xxd -r` payloads so that a `.config/` path carried as encoded text cannot pass the operator-path guard.
acceptanceCriteria: Red first: the worker adds the deny cases below to `.agro/scripts/__tests__/hooks.test.ts` and records that each new deny case fails before the hook change.

When the command contains `base64 -d`, `base64 --decode`, `base64 -D`, or `xxd -r`, the hook decodes each literal payload token. The hook tests the decoded text against `OPERATOR_PATH` and `SECRET_PATH`.
The hook denies `echo <base64 of "cat ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml"> | base64 -d | sh` and the same payload written with `> run.sh`.
The hook denies a `base64 -d` or `xxd -r` decode that a shell runs (`| sh`, `| bash`, `$(...)`) inside `docker exec`, `agro hands exec`, `ssh`, or `bash -c`. The payload content does not matter.
The hook allows `echo aGVsbG8= | base64 -d` and `base64 -d image.b64 > image.png`.
The denial reason names the remedy. The operator pastes the value, or the agent names the path in prose through `--body-file` or a heredoc.
Test sources build each encoded fixture at run time with `Buffer.from(...).toString("base64")`. No protected path appears as a literal in the test file.
`corepack pnpm vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/hooks.test.ts` exits 0.

userStories.description: As the operator, I want a command transcript in `.agro/tasks/secret-guard-variants/evidence/manual-review.md` so that I can verify each variant without reading the regexes.
acceptanceCriteria: The transcript holds the output of `corepack pnpm vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/hooks.test.ts` with each new case name and its result.
